title: Link
description: A link to a specific image crop

height.description: The height of the linked image file (in pixels)

width.description: The width of the linked image file (in pixels)

hrefTemplate.description: An RFC6570 compliant URI template with {width}, {quality}, and {format} as parameters; this template may be used to construct a URI pointing to a resized version of this image. {width} is the desired width in pixels of the resized image. {quality} is the percentage of the image's original quality remaining in the resized image (1-100). {format} is the desired image format as an extension ('jpg', 'png').
